residual.name: Tuition budgeted but not matched to a payment shown here
residual.why: CPS pays many other private schools, and the payments file does not say which budget line each payment belongs to, so this part has no provider boxes.

splits.note: 23 more private schools were found by matching CPS FY2026 payment names to the State Board of Education's directory of approved nonpublic special education schools (together $11,858,311.70). Left out on purpose: agencies that run many services (UCAN, JCFS, Maryville, Rush and others), and names that did not match the same city.
